description: Amazon Athena metadata connector (Tier-3, no-row-data). Indexes data catalogs, databases, and table metadata — table names, types, column names/types, partition keys, parameters, and timestamps — via the AWS CLI's Athena metadata commands. Never runs a query or fetches row, cell, or query-result data. Reuses the existing AWS credentials via the aws CLI. Read-only; no write tools.
author: Nimbus
